image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a rocky intertidal zone. The central subject is a dark, oval-shaped marine mollusk (chiton) clinging to the rock, characterized by eight distinct dorsal plates. To the left and bottom are bright orange and purple starfish (sea stars) with textured, bumpy surfaces. The background consists of rough, wet rock with patches of pink coralline algae.
